name: file-explorer
description: Browse and read files on the machine running Kiro Crew without leaving the dashboard. Keep several files open in tabs, walk the directory tree with each file's git status shown beside it, search a whole folder for a string (including inside Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files), and view many file types in place: markdown rendered, PDFs, images, HTML pages, CSV/TSV tables, Office documents with slide colours and layout, and audio/video. Markdown files can be edited in place with auto-save; every other file type stays strictly read-only, and reachable paths are limited to your home directory, /tmp, and /opt.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Markdown files are editable in place with auto-save and change-on-disk protection; everything else stays read-only
Views PDFs, images, HTML previews, CSV/TSV tables, Word/Excel/PowerPoint content, and audio/video in place
PowerPoint slides render with their real colours, positions, and embedded images
Folder search also finds words inside Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files
Directory tree shows each file's git status inline
Reachable paths are limited to your home directory, /tmp, and /opt — symlinks out are refused
